observations: A flatbed truck chassis (cab marked 'NISSAN DIESEL' visible on the grille, photo 2) fitted with an orange mast/drilling rig superstructure.
Rig and truck body show heavy rust, dust and faded paint; appears to have been stationary for a long time (dust/sediment on tires, dirt around wheels).
A hand-written/taped sign on the windshield reads something like 'Bent Rack Steering / No Hand Signal' (photo 2) — unclear meaning, but suggests a known steering issue.
No photo shows the engine running, hydraulic rams extended, drill bit turning, or any operational demonstration.
No photos of engine bay, hydraulic pump, control panel, or drill pipe/bit condition.
Vehicle is parked among other heavy equipment (loaders) in what looks like a yard, not an active job site.

claims.evidence: No video or photo shows the engine running or the rig drilling; only static shots.
No service receipt, sticker, or dated proof visible in any photo.
Heavy rust and dirt in photos 0-1 obscure many components (hydraulics, hoses, drill pipes); completeness cannot be confirmed.
No plate, serial number, or manufacturer tag is legible in any photo.

risks.risk: Engine and hydraulic system may not actually run or may need major repair.
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine starting and the mast/rotary head operating under load.

risks.risk: Steering defect implied by the windshield sign ('Bent Rack Steering / No Hand Signal').
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the steering rack/linkage and a short driving clip.
risks.if_unproven: priced as faulty steering, needing repair

risks.risk: Long idle time (dust, weeds, static tires) suggests seized parts, dried seals, or flat-spotted tires.
risks.proof: Dated video showing the rig being moved and mast raised/lowered.

risks.risk: Corrosion on mast, drill pipes, and winch cables could compromise structural safety.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of mast joints, pipe threads, and cable condition.

risks.risk: No registration/ownership documents shown, raising resale/title risk.
risks.proof: Photo of vehicle particulars/registration and proof of ownership.

proof_requests: Video of the engine running and the drill rig actually drilling or at least mast raising/lowering with hydraulics working.
Close-up photos of the steering rack area referenced by the windshield sign.
Photo of service record/receipt from the claimed recent servicing.
Close-up of drill pipes, bit, and winch cable condition.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a truck-mounted borehole drilling rig on a Nissan Diesel chassis, but none of the seller's working/service/completeness claims are supported by the photos, and a possible steering defect is flagged by the seller's own sign, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-working, unverified rig.
